Inside the NFL Model

How the Yardage Stack Works

A compact weekly ensemble designed around the NBA repository’s sequence, boosted-tree, stacking, and uncertainty-aware evaluation patterns.

Loading methodology...

Architecture

  1. Player form, volume, volatility, and opponent allowances are summarized over lagged three- and five-game windows.
  2. A regularized Ridge model captures stable linear relationships while a Huber-loss gradient booster captures interactions.
  3. A positive Ridge meta-learner combines those estimates with a five-game rolling baseline.
  4. After the untouched holdout is scored, the deployable base models are refit through the validated season.

Backtest Integrity

    What “Accuracy” Means

    • MAE: average absolute difference between predicted and actual yards.
    • R²: share of holdout variance explained by the projection.
    • Within tolerance: the share within 30 passing yards or 15 rushing/receiving yards.
    • Baseline improvement: MAE reduction against a player’s trailing five-game average.
